# Classification Neural Network Learner

Calls
[`deepnet::nn.train()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/deepnet/man/nn.train.html)
from [deepnet](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=deepnet).

## Initial parameter values

- `output` is set to `"softmax"` for probabilistic classification.

## Dictionary

This [Learner](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/reference/Learner.html) can be
instantiated via
[lrn()](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/reference/mlr_sugar.html):

    lrn("classif.nnTrain")

## Meta Information

- Task type: “classif”

- Predict Types: “response”, “prob”

- Feature Types: “integer”, “numeric”

- Required Packages: [mlr3](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=mlr3),
  [deepnet](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=deepnet)

## Parameters

|  |  |  |  |  |
|----|----|----|----|----|
| Id | Type | Default | Levels | Range |
| activationfun | character | sigm | sigm, linear, tanh | \- |
| batchsize | integer | 100 |  | \\\[1, \infty)\\ |
| hidden | untyped | 10L |  | \- |
| hidden_dropout | numeric | 0 |  | \\\[0, 1\]\\ |
| initB | untyped | \- |  | \- |
| initW | untyped | \- |  | \- |
| learningrate | numeric | 0.8 |  | \\\[0, \infty)\\ |
| learningrate_scale | numeric | 1 |  | \\\[0, \infty)\\ |
| max_number_of_layers | integer | \- |  | \\\[1, \infty)\\ |
| momentum | numeric | 0.5 |  | \\\[0, \infty)\\ |
| numepochs | integer | 3 |  | \\\[1, \infty)\\ |
| output | character | \- | sigm, linear, softmax | \- |
| visible_dropout | numeric | 0 |  | \\\[0, 1\]\\ |

### `LearnerClassifNNTrain$clone()`

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

#### Usage

    LearnerClassifNNTrain$clone(deep = FALSE)

#### Arguments

- `deep`:

  Whether to make a deep clone.

## Examples

``` r
# Define the Learner
learner = lrn("classif.nnTrain")
print(learner)
#> 
#> ── <LearnerClassifNNTrain> (classif.nnTrain): Training Neural Network by Backpro
#> • Model: -
#> • Parameters: output=softmax
#> • Packages: mlr3 and deepnet
#> • Predict Types: [response] and prob
#> • Feature Types: integer and numeric
#> • Encapsulation: none (fallback: -)
#> • Properties: multiclass and twoclass
#> • Other settings: use_weights = 'error', predict_raw = 'FALSE'

# Define a Task
task = tsk("sonar")

# Create train and test set
ids = partition(task)

# Train the learner on the training ids
learner$train(task, row_ids = ids$train)

print(learner$model)
```
